Job description

-Role & responsibilities :- Roles & Responsibilities (Short)


Call potential customers and explain the company's E-commerce and Digital Marketing plans.


Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable plans.


Convert leads into sales by explaining plan benefits.


Follow up with interested customers.


Achieve sales targets and maintain daily call records.



Preferred candidate profile


-Good communication skills in Hindi and basic English.


-Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.


-Comfortable with Work From Home.


-Target-oriented and confident in speaking with customers.


-Laptop and stable internet connection required.
